summary: Planet 13 Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a merger agreement with Vireo Growth Inc. and its subsidiary Supernova Merger Sub Inc. Under the agreement, Merger Sub will merge into Planet 13, with Planet 13 surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Vireo. Each share of Planet 13 common stock will be converted into 0.015383618 subordinate voting shares of Vireo, implying a stock-for-stock exchange. The board, acting on a unanimous special committee recommendation, approved the merger and recommends stockholders vote in favor. Terms include customary representations, warranties, and ordinary-course covenants. Watch for stockholder approval, regulatory clearances, and closing conditions.
